resolved_findings.resolution: The accepted additive migration 004 replaces the revision-1 identities with evidence-scoped document/chunk identities. The V2 adapter now targets the exact revision-2 document/evidence/chunk conflict columns, and an offline processor-to-row regression proves four same-content dataset/retrieval/effective observations remain unique under both revision-2 constraints.

Historical loading independently rejects provider rows outside the normalized requested ticker set. The local JSON provider also filters requested tickers defensively. Processor evidence identity now includes a ticker-plus-complete-metadata association hash so multi-ticker and metadata-distinct observations coexist. Resume identity additionally hashes canonical full RawDocument and processed-record manifests, detecting ticker or metadata mutation before completed Vector reuse or Graph retry.

A loaded checkpoint without materialization identity is retryable only when neither Vector nor Graph has completed work. Missing credentials and transient load/process failures can retry the same request safely; a completed Vector or Graph checkpoint without identity still fails closed with INGESTION_RESUME_FINGERPRINT_MISSING.

identity_contract.requested_ticker_policy: Historical provider output is independently constrained to the normalized requested ticker set; out-of-scope rows are quarantined.
identity_contract.evidence_association: Evidence identity binds document identity, normalized ticker, complete metadata hash, dataset version, publication/retrieval/effective interval, and filing time.
identity_contract.resume_policy: Incomplete pre-materialization failure may retry only with the same request fingerprint and no completed work; completed work requires a complete exact materialization identity.
